definitions.full: H8292. sheruqah or sheriqah [ שְׁרִיקָה ] noun [feminine] hissing , perhaps also whistling, piping ; — plural absolute (intensive) שְׁרִיקֹת Jer 18:16 Qr hissing , in derision, + שַׁמָּה (see שְׁרֵקָה ), Kt שרוקת ; construct עֲדָרִים שְׁרִקוֺת Judg 5:16 as signal hissings (or whistlings, pipings) for flocks . שׁרר (√ of [ שָׁרִיר ], שְׁרִירוּת , and perhaps of other words following; Old Aramaic שר be firm sound , Aramaic שְׁרַר be firm, hard , be firm, consistent, substantial, truthful , strengthen confirm : Aramaic and Late Hebrew שָׁרִיר firm, hard ; firmness, strength, constancy ).
